name: YuXin Kylin 3x3 (Cutout)
description: The YuXin Black Kirin 3x3 Cutout is a lightweight twist on the classic 3x3. Its pieces have sections cut out to reduce weight and give the cube a unique, airy feel while turning. This design helps create a faster, more flexible experience that’s great for casual solving or experimenting with new turning styles. It’s a fun, budget-friendly option with a distinct look and performance
